heatmap.netHint: Signed labels show who controls the square more strongly.
heatmap.splitHint: Labels show white:black control counts for contested squares.
heatmap.valueGuideBody: These numbers are not engine eval. They show the control difference on a square.
heatmap.valuePlusExample: white has 4 more attackers on that square than black.
heatmap.valueMinusExample: black has 5 more attackers on that square than white.
heatmap.netExample: In Net mode, positive means white pressure and negative means black pressure.
heatmap.splitExample: In Split mode, a 3:1 label means 3 white attacks and 1 black attack.
heatmap.traceHint: Alt + right-click a square to reveal the pieces influencing it.
heatmap.traceKeyboardHint: Esc clears selection, I toggles trace arrows.

analysisLegend.title: Analysis tools
analysisLegend.engineDesc: Toggles Stockfish engine analysis. When active, the engine evaluates the current position and shows the top candidate lines.
analysisLegend.guessDesc: Hides engine evaluation, arrows, and best-move lines so you can try to find the best move yourself before peeking.
analysisLegend.revealDesc: Temporarily reveals the hidden analysis for the current position. Analysis hides again when you move to a new position.
analysisLegend.analyzeGameDesc: Runs the engine through every position in the loaded game, classifying each move (brilliant, great, best, good, inaccuracy, mistake, blunder).
analysisLegend.arrowsDesc: Arrows show the first move of each engine line. The colour matches the bar next to the line in the analysis panel; the best line has the thickest arrow.
